verdict.rationale: Linear offers two paths toward custom agents: Loops let users describe recurring jobs in plain language and trigger them on schedule/events (linear-docs-36, linear-docs-11, linear-docs-77), and Linear's Agents API/framework lets developers build agents that behave like workspace members, get @mentioned/delegated issues, and can be published to Linear's integration directory (linear-docs-16, linear-docs-54, linear-docs-64, linear-docs-65, linear-docs-75). This is real first-party support for building/configuring agents, but the deeper 'build agents that investigate incidents, monitor SLAs' capability requires developer/API work rather than a simple no-code in-app builder, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of end-users actually building custom agents this way. Missing for 10: a no-code in-product agent builder UI beyond Loops, and independent corroboration of users successfully building custom agents.
